nodes.notes: 1) Classification: fused conv2d(3x3,s1,p1) + bias + ReLU + AvgPool2d(2). Dense regular access; reductions over (C_in, kH, kW) per output channel; spatial 720x1280. 2) Canonical: y[n,oc,h,w] = relu(sum_{ic,kh,kw} x[n,ic,h+kh-1,w+kw-1]*w[oc,ic,kh,kw] + b[oc]); pooled[n,oc,i,j] = (y[*,*,2i,2j]+...+y[*,*,2i+1,2j+1])/4. 3) Layout: NCHW fp16 contiguous; weights 32x16x3x3 (small, fit in shared/const); input 1x16x720x1280; output post-pool 1x32x360x640. 4) Regimes: (a) memory-bound bulk (interior tiles) — limited by global input reads with halo reuse; (b) edge-bound (padding) — divergence on borders; (c) compute-fusion — fusing conv+bias+relu+pool eliminates an entire intermediate write of 28MB. 5) Knobs: tile size (output H x W), use of shared mem for input halo, fuse pool into conv (write per pool output), use of __half2 vectorization, wmma vs CUDA cores (small K=16*9=144), const mem for weights, channels in registers per block. 6) Skeleton: each block computes a tile of pooled output (e.g., 16x32 pooled = 32x64 conv output) for all 32 oc; load input halo (16+2 x 64+2 x 16 ic) into shared; iterate ic, kh, kw accumulating 32 oc per spatial; apply bias+relu+avgpool; write. 7) Families: F1 Direct fused conv+pool with shared-mem halo and CUDA-core FMA in __half2; F2 Implicit GEMM via wmma tensor cores reshaping conv to GEMM (M=N*H*W,K=C_in*9,N=32) plus separate fused pool; F3 Two-kernel pipeline (cuDNN-like conv) + fused pool kernel.

action.description: Implement a single fused CUDA kernel that computes conv2d(3x3, pad=1) + bias + ReLU + AvgPool2x2 in one pass. Each block produces a tile of pooled outputs (e.g., 8x16 pooled => 16x32 conv) for all 32 output channels. Input halo for all 16 input channels staged in shared memory; weights kept in constant or shared memory. Use __half2 vectorization where possible.
action.rationale: Eliminates intermediate 28MB conv tensor write/read; small Cin/Cout fits well in shared/const memory; pool output is half the conv elements so writing pooled directly halves output BW.
action.title: Fused Conv3x3+Bias+ReLU+AvgPool2 single kernel (shared halo)

action.description: Implement implicit GEMM using wmma (or mma) tensor-core fp16 accumulate-fp32: reshape conv as M=H*W (per output spatial), K=Cin*9=144, N=Cout=32. Pad K to 160 (multiple of 16) and N is 32 (two 16-wide tiles). Im2col is implicit per-block via shared-mem halo gather. Then a small fused epilogue kernel applies bias+ReLU+AvgPool2.
action.rationale: Tensor cores boost throughput for the conv; implicit im2col avoids materialization. However small N=32 underutilizes tensor cores; epilogue split adds an extra pass.
action.title: Implicit GEMM (wmma) + fused pool epilogue

kernel_summary: Fused conv2d(3x3, stride1, pad1, 16->32) + bias + ReLU + AvgPool2x2 in fp16 NCHW on a 1x16x720x1280 input, producing 1x32x360x640. Compute is moderate (16*9=144 MACs per output channel per spatial) and the tensor is bandwidth-leaning (~28MB input, ~15MB pooled output). Weights are tiny (~9KB) and fit in constant/shared memory. Key constraints: small Cin/Cout limit tensor-core efficiency; padding on borders requires careful bounds handling; fusing pool with conv halves output writes and avoids materializing the 28MB activation. Numerical tolerance is loose (rtol=atol=0.01) so fp16 accumulation paths are acceptable but fp32 accumulator is safer.
